notes.title: Happy Halloween~ We're live!
notes.notes:
Sugar, spice, and everything fright!  Witches x Warlocks is finally live!

Here's a quick overview of the differences between the Free and the Full version.

If you have purchased the DLC, please make sure you've got it installed!
[i]You can quickly check if you've got the full version in the Main Menu.[/i] A "Free Version" will be displayed in the top left corner if it's not the DLC.

[b]The free version contains 3 love interests: Zero, Damion, Carmilla.
It has 23 spells, 3 CGs and 10 mini chibi illustrations.
[/b]
[b]The full version comes with 1 additional love interest: Lawrence.
It also has an additional of 5 spells, another 5 CGs and 40+ mini chibi illustrations.[/b]

If you encounter any bugs or troubles, please feel free to post it in the Community Hub!

Stay spooky and a Happy Halloween to you guys!
Nifty Visuals team
